svg.title: Certificates, monitoring, and local state
svg.desc: Host services use lego. Kubernetes uses cert-manager. Uptime Kuma stores monitor state in its own SQLite database.

g.text: Host services use lego. Kubernetes uses cert-manager. Uptime Kuma stores monitor state in its own SQLite database.
/var/lib/lego holds ACME accounts, keys, and certs.
Hooks validate files and activate them per service.
DNS consumes PFX; the other services consume PEM.
Vault reloads TLS with SIGHUP, preserving unsealed
ESO supplies the Cloudflare token from Vault.
cert-manager uses DNS-01 + public DoH self-checks.
Certificates cover Argo CD and Hubble UI.
Kuma probes its configured service endpoints.
Kuma alerts: native Brevo provider / HTTPS API.
Daily + up to 1h jitter; validate before retention.
Backup and live state share the container root disk.
Hubble observes Kubernetes network flows. Kuma runs configured uptime checks; the cluster has no general monitoring stack.
